run_solver: run the run_solver function to solve a MIP with a configured solver and return solution data and stats
create_SCIPSolver: create a SCIPSolver instance to solve MIPs using the classical SCIP solver
create_NeuralDivingSolver: create a NeuralDivingSolver instance to solve MIPs using neural diving predictions
create_NeuralNSSolver: create a NeuralNSSolver instance to solve MIPs using neural neighbourhood selection
call_predict_and_create_sub_mip: call predict_and_create_sub_mip to generate a sub-MIP from model predictions on binary variables
